objective: Define the evidence policy for admitting historical Telegram artifacts into point-in-time research.
prompt:
VALIDATION LEVEL: FAST

Act as research-integrity reviewer.

Read the canonical research protocol and JOB-0006 through JOB-0011
audit/experiment documents. Inspect implementation only where needed.

PRIMARY QUESTION

Can evidence classified as
B_SOURCE_VERIFIED_CONTENT_STRONGLY_SUPPORTED
be admitted into the three-year historical Top30 research?

Current B evidence for message 15617 includes:

- genuine Telegram message identity verified;
- Telegram source timestamp verified;
- current Telegram content canonically matches the independently preserved
  legacy local artifact;
- legacy artifact matches the existing processed-manifest hash;
- no edit timestamp is currently reported;
- exact acquisition-time digest/timestamp and historical revision history
  remain unavailable.

Do not require mathematically perfect historical proof if that standard would
make the practical research impossible.

Instead define a conservative, reproducible evidence policy.

REQUIRED DECISIONS

Define policy for evidence classes A/B/C/D/E:

1. whether each class may enter:
   - parsing only;
   - historical assessment;
   - outcome evaluation;
   - full three-year walk-forward research;

2. required restrictions for admitted classes;

3. confidence/evidence metadata that must remain attached permanently;

4. whether unresolved stock identity is allowed;

5. whether retrospective corrections may be applied and, if so, at which
   research stage;

6. whether B evidence may be promoted from quarantine for assessment without
   pretending it is A-grade evidence.

Prevent survivorship/look-ahead leakage and silent evidence upgrading.

MESSAGE 15617 DECISION

Give an explicit policy decision for the existing JOB-0011 fixture:

PROMOTE_WITH_RESTRICTIONS
KEEP_QUARANTINED
REQUIRE_ONE_SPECIFIC_ADDITIONAL_EVIDENCE

If additional evidence is required, name the exact evidence required.
Do not recommend open-ended provenance investigation.

IMPLEMENTATION

If the policy supports PROMOTE_WITH_RESTRICTIONS:

- implement the smallest explicit policy gate required to permit B-grade
  evidence into assessment;
- preserve evidence_class=B and all limitations in derived artifacts;
- do not change the underlying provenance classification;
- do not silently convert B to A.

If policy rejects promotion, do not implement a bypass.

Do not add outcome data in this job.

VALIDATION

Run only directly affected policy/contract tests plus core point-in-time
leakage tests.

Do NOT run the entire test suite unless the change affects shared foundations
or focused tests reveal a regression.

Run git diff --check.

DOCUMENTATION

Create:

docs/policies/historical-evidence-admission-policy.md

Record:

- A/B/C/D/E admission matrix;
- restrictions;
- confidence semantics;
- correction policy;
- unresolved-identity policy;
- decision for message 15617;
- rationale;
- known limitations.

FINAL VERDICT

End with exactly one:

B_EVIDENCE_ADMITTED_WITH_RESTRICTIONS
B_EVIDENCE_NOT_ADMITTED
ADDITIONAL_SPECIFIC_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED

Do not authorize bulk three-year execution yet.

Report the recommended next step concisely.

Do not commit or push.
